hero.title: Stop guessing <hl>what to build.</hl>
hero.subtitle: Post a problem you want solved. Upvote the ones you have too. Builders solve the most wanted.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: "I want an app that…" Describe what's missing in your day.
how.step2Body: The problems most people care about rise to the top.
how.step3Body: Developers ship solutions. Users vote for the best one.

examples.title: Example problems
examples.subtitle: Nothing posted yet. Here's the kind of thing we mean.

newIssue.subtitle: Describe the problem you want solved. Focus on what bugs you, not the solution.

solution.subtitle: Built something for this problem? Share it. People will vote for the best one.
solution.urlHint: Website, App Store or Play Store link. Must start with https://
solution.bodyPlaceholder: How does it solve the problem?

solution.claimFirstBody: Tap “I'm building this” on the problem. You can submit your solution an hour later. This keeps out bots that spam every problem.
solution.claimWaitBody: You claimed this problem recently. You can submit your solution in {{minutes}} min.

signin.title: Sign in to BuildThis
signin.subtitle: Post problems, upvote, and ship solutions.
signin.terms: By continuing you agree to let us store your name and email to run your account.
signin.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

signin.notVerified: Not confirmed yet. Open the link in the email first.

me.deleteConfirm: Delete your account? This can't be undone.
me.photoHint: Shown next to your name on your problems and solutions.
